headline: Ibovespa Rises 1.39% Led by C&A Gains as US Dollar Advances Against Real
summary: The Ibovespa index closed up 1.39% at 168,498.45 points, driven by a 23.82% surge in C&A shares, while the US dollar rose 1.18% against the Brazilian real to finish at R$5.5087.
why: Benchmark stock index movements and exchange rate fluctuations reflect shifting investor sentiment and currency risk in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Index gains reflect broader positive equity performance across constituent equities on the B3 exchange.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong gains in key retail equities like C&A helped lift the broader benchmark index despite currency pressures.
